description: This Python module initializes and manages an SQLite database for a backend API, including schema creation, connection handling, and system user setup.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Authentication service used for password hashing and user management.

methods.name: _default_db_path
methods.description: Computes a deterministic default database path based on the container root directory.

methods.name: _fallback_db_path
methods.description: Provides a writable fallback path in /tmp for the database.

methods.name: _connect_sqlite
methods.description: Creates a SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled and sets row factory.

methods.name: _ensure_parent_dir
methods.description: Ensures the parent directory exists for a given database path.

methods.name: _ensure_system_user
methods.description: Ensures a 'system' user exists in the users table, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: get_db_path
methods.description: Retrieves the database path from environment variables or defaults to a deterministic path.

methods.name: get_connection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a singleton SQLite connection, with fallback mechanisms for degraded mode.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: db_status
methods.description: Checks database connectivity and returns status, path, and degraded mode indicator.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, creating tables and indexes, and ensures the system user exists.

methods.name: seed_test_users
methods.description: Seeds the database with default test users for development and testing.
